subject: Fix signal mask parsing on 32-bit systems (#4415)
reason: This is a 32-bit-only correctness fix with no observable effect on the 64-bit servers the fuzzer runs. The widened type (unsigned long -> unsigned long long) and 1L -> 1ULL shift only matter where `unsigned long` is 32 bits; on a 64-bit (x86_64) build `unsigned long` is already 64 bits, so parsing the 64-bit signal mask, the overflow check, and the mask bit test all behave identically before and after the change. The affected function `string2ull_base16_async_signal_safe` is an internal, async-signal-safe helper reached only from `is_thread_ready_to_signal` -> `get_ready_to_signal_threads_tids
